Decadal genetic diversity trend analysis in Indian rice varieties To understand the genetic diversity trend in Indian rice varieties released and notified from 1940 to 2013 an interval of 10-years was taken to keep the number of varieties almost constant in each interval. Except for interval 1940–1965, which was about 26 years, other in- tervals were about 10 years. Decadal analysis showed a steady increase in gene diversity of varieties released during 1966–1975 (0.314), 1976–1985 (0.315), 1986– 1995 (0.335), 1996–2005 (0.346) but it showed decreas- ing trend during 2006–2013 (0.290).
